# opencode-message-rail

English | [简体中文](README.zh.md)

A right-edge message rail for the [OpenCode](https://opencode.ai) TUI: one tick per user
turn, chevrons for previous/next, a dwell-hover preview card, and click-to-jump.

[![CI](https://github.com/maxvalla/opencode-message-rail/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/maxvalla/opencode-message-rail/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

Requires OpenCode **≥ 2.3.2** (TUI plugin API 2.3.2) and OpenTUI **≥ 0.8.4**.

## Install

The package is not on npm yet, so install from source:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/maxvalla/opencode-message-rail.git
cd opencode-message-rail
npm install                                   # installs deps and builds dist/
```

Then add the checkout to `~/.config/opencode/opencode.json` and restart the TUI:

```json
{
  "plugins": ["file:/abs/path/to/opencode-message-rail"]
}
```

Use the `file:` form for a directory — a bare path does not load the TUI half, and the
`npm install` step is required: the repository ships sources, and `prepare` builds `dist/`.

Once the package is published to npm this becomes:

```bash
opencode plugin opencode-message-rail -g    # global config (~/.config/opencode)
opencode plugin opencode-message-rail       # this project only
```

`opencode plugin github:maxvalla/opencode-message-rail` does **not** work on OpenCode 2.3.2:
the installer blocks the package's `prepare` script, so no `dist/` is produced.

## Keys

| Key | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `Alt+R` | Toggle the rail (persisted across restarts) |
| `Alt+[` / `Alt+]` | Previous / next turn |
| Click a tick | Jump to that turn |
| Click `↑` / `↓` | Jump to the turn above / below the viewport top |
| Wheel over the rail | Scroll the transcript (no click required) |
| `/rail` | Toggle from the prompt |

## Configuration

Options live under the plugin's `options` object:

```json
{
  "plugins": [
    {
      "name": "opencode-message-rail",
      "options": { "enabled": true, "wheelLines": 3, "dwellMs": 120 }
    }
  ]
}
```

| Option | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | `true` | Start with the rail shown (still togglable with `Alt+R`) |
| `wheelLines` | `3` | Transcript lines per wheel notch over the rail (clamped to 1–5) |
| `dwellMs` | `120` | Hover dwell before the preview card opens |
| `debugFile` | `""` | Write a JSON state snapshot here for troubleshooting — see Privacy |

## How it works

- The rail occupies the transcript column's right padding (2 columns), positioned from the
  scrollbox's own `screenX`/`width` and its parent's rect — never from the renderer width.
- Four capability tiers degrade instead of failing: `0` no session, `1` probe failed,
  `2` turn order known but positions unknown (even spacing), `3` exact anchoring.
- All host reads are wrapped: a shape change disables the rail, never the TUI. Three errors
  inside 10 s lock it out for 30 s.
- Jumps escalate: direct scroll → expand window → replay host navigation → paginate history.
  A toast appears only after every rung fails.
- Pointer input has two sources feeding one sink: native JSX handlers on the overlay and a
  raw SGR parser on `renderer.stdin` (the host consumes mouse input before plugins see it).
  The first native event that resolves to a real rail row retires the SGR parser;
  `debugFile`'s `pointerSource` reports which path won.

## Compatibility

| | |
| --- | --- |
| OpenCode | ≥ 2.3.2; verified interactively on 2.3.2 (macOS) |
| OpenTUI | ≥ 0.8.4 (native-backed `ScrollBox`) |
| Terminal | needs ≥ 44 columns for the rail and its gutter; narrower terminals shrink the card |
| Platform | macOS and Linux; Windows terminals are untested |

Versions are pinned to the floor the host guarantees, not to the newest release, and every
newer host capability is duck-typed — a build without `afterLayout` or
`scrollChildIntoView` falls back to the previous, verified path.

## Troubleshooting

**No rail at all.** Check `tier` in `debugFile`: `0` means you are not on a session route,
`1` means the transcript scrollbox could not be found or read. If a second plugin claims
`session.composer.top`, the two overlays may overlap.

**Rail appears but ticks never highlight the current turn** (`tier` stuck at `2`) — the
mounted rows do not carry message ids. The rail still works; it just cannot show which turn
you are in.

**`pointerSource` is `"sgr"`.** That build still consumes mouse input before plugins see it,
so clicks are routed from the raw stdin sequence. Everything works; it is the fallback.

**Hover card opens in the wrong place.** Please open an issue with the debug snapshot — the
card anchors to the rail row the tick was painted on, so a mismatch means the layout changed.

**`opencode plugin github:…` fails with `git dep preparation failed`.** Expected on 2.3.2 —
the installer blocks the package's `prepare`, so `dist/` is never built. Install from source
as described above.

**`Alt+R` clashes with another plugin.** Set `enabled: false` in the options instead of
toggling, or rebind via the command palette command ids `message-rail.toggle`,
`message-rail.prev`, `message-rail.next`.

## Privacy

The plugin makes **no network requests**. It reads the current session's message list (ids,
timestamps and text — the text is what the hover card shows) from the host's local cache.

`debugFile` writes a JSON snapshot on a timer, and that snapshot **contains message text**
(the card's rendered lines are not included, but ids and geometry are, and the turn list is).
Use it for troubleshooting only, point it at a scratch path, and delete the file afterwards.

## Development

```bash
npm install      # also builds dist/ via prepare
npm run typecheck
npm test
npm run build
```

Tests need [Bun](https://bun.sh) (`bun test`). They run with `--conditions=browser`: solid-js's
`node` export condition resolves to its SSR build, where `createMemo` never invalidates, and
the controller tests would assert against a frozen view. `src/geom.test.ts` covers the pure
geometry; `src/controller.test.ts` drives the real controller against a fake host and needs no
terminal.

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) for the module map and the invariants that must hold.

# opencode-message-rail

[English](README.md) | 简体中文

一个 [OpenCode](https://opencode.ai) TUI 插件：在对话区右侧边缘显示一条「消息导轨」，每轮用户消息对应一根刻度（tick），两端有上/下箭头，悬停停留后弹出预览卡片，点击刻度即可跳转到对应消息。

[![CI](https://github.com/maxvalla/opencode-message-rail/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/maxvalla/opencode-message-rail/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

要求 OpenCode **≥ 2.3.2**（TUI 插件 API 2.3.2）、OpenTUI **≥ 0.8.4**。

## 安装

包还没发布到 npm，目前从源码安装：

```bash
git clone https://github.com/maxvalla/opencode-message-rail.git
cd opencode-message-rail
npm install                                   # 安装依赖并构建 dist/
```

然后把检出目录写进 `~/.config/opencode/opencode.json`，重启 TUI：

```json
{
  "plugins": ["file:/绝对路径/opencode-message-rail"]
}
```

目录**必须用 `file:` 形式**——直接写裸路径不会加载 TUI 部分；`npm install` 这一步也不能省：仓库里是源码，`dist/` 由 `prepare` 构建。

等包发布到 npm 之后，安装会简化成：

```bash
opencode plugin opencode-message-rail -g    # 写入全局配置（~/.config/opencode）
opencode plugin opencode-message-rail       # 仅当前项目
```

`opencode plugin github:maxvalla/opencode-message-rail` 在 OpenCode 2.3.2 上**不可用**：安装器会拦截包里的 `prepare` 脚本，导致没有 `dist/`。

## 按键

| 按键 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `Alt+R` | 显示 / 隐藏导轨（跨重启保持） |
| `Alt+[` / `Alt+]` | 上一轮 / 下一轮 |
| 点击刻度 | 跳转到该轮 |
| 点击 `↑` / `↓` | 跳到视口上方 / 下方的最近一轮 |
| 在导轨上滚轮 | 滚动对话区（不需要点击） |
| `/rail` | 在输入框内切换开关 |

## 配置

选项写在插件的 `options` 里：

```json
{
  "plugins": [
    {
      "name": "opencode-message-rail",
      "options": { "enabled": true, "wheelLines": 3, "dwellMs": 120 }
    }
  ]
}
```

| 选项 | 默认值 | 含义 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | `true` | 启动时是否显示导轨（仍可用 `Alt+R` 切换） |
| `wheelLines` | `3` | 在导轨上滚一格滚动多少行（限制在 1–5） |
| `dwellMs` | `120` | 悬停多久后弹出预览卡片 |
| `debugFile` | `""` | 把 JSON 状态快照写到这个路径，用于排障——见「隐私」 |

## 工作原理

- 导轨占用的位置是对话列自身的右侧内边距（2 列），坐标取自 scrollbox 的 `screenX`/`width` 与其父容器的矩形，**不用** renderer 的宽度。
- 能力分四档，逐级降级而不是报错：`0` 不在会话页，`1` 探针失败，`2` 知道轮次顺序但不知道位置（均匀排布），`3` 精确锚定。
- 所有宿主读取都包在 `guard()` 里：宿主结构变化只会让导轨消失，不会让 TUI 崩掉。10 秒内累计 3 次错误会锁定 30 秒。
- 跳转分级：直接滚动 → 展开窗口 → 回放宿主导航 → 分页加载历史。只有全部失败才弹 toast。
- 指针输入有两个来源、汇聚到同一个 sink：overlay 上的原生 JSX 回调，以及 `renderer.stdin` 上的原始 SGR 解析（宿主会在插件之前消费鼠标事件）。第一个能解析出真实导轨行的原生事件会让 SGR 解析器自动退休；`debugFile` 里的 `pointerSource` 会告诉你哪条路在生效。

## 兼容性

| | |
| --- | --- |
| OpenCode | ≥ 2.3.2；在 2.3.2（macOS）上做过交互验证 |
| OpenTUI | ≥ 0.8.4（原生后端的 `ScrollBox`） |
| 终端 | 建议 ≥ 44 列；更窄时导轨仍在，但预览卡片会变窄 |
| 平台 | macOS、Linux；Windows 终端未验证 |

版本按「宿主保证的下限」对齐、而不是追最新版，且所有更新的宿主能力都走 duck-typing：没有 `afterLayout` 或 `scrollChildIntoView` 的构建会回落到之前已验证的路径。

## 排障

**完全看不到导轨。** 看 `debugFile` 里的 `tier`：`0` 表示当前不在会话页；`1` 表示找不到或读不到对话区 scrollbox。如果另一个插件也占了 `session.composer.top`，两个 overlay 可能重叠。

**导轨在，但当前轮次从不高亮**（`tier` 一直停在 `2`）——已挂载的行没有携带消息 id。导轨仍可用，只是无法标出你正处在哪一轮。

**`pointerSource` 是 `"sgr"`。** 说明这个构建仍会在插件之前消费鼠标事件，点击是通过原始 stdin 序列路由的。功能正常，只是走了兜底路径。

**悬停卡片位置不对。** 请带 debug 快照开 issue——卡片锚定在刻度**实际被绘制的那一行**，出现偏差意味着布局变了。

**`opencode plugin github:…` 报 `git dep preparation failed`。** 在 2.3.2 上是预期行为：安装器拦截了 `prepare`，不会生成 `dist/`。请按上面的「从源码安装」操作。

**`Alt+R` 与别的插件冲突。** 用 `enabled: false` 关掉，或通过命令面板改键，命令 id 是 `message-rail.toggle`、`message-rail.prev`、`message-rail.next`。

## 隐私

插件**不发起任何网络请求**。它只从宿主的本地缓存读取当前会话的消息列表（id、时间戳、正文——正文用于预览卡片）。

`debugFile` 会定时写入 JSON 快照，其中**包含消息 id 与轮次列表**（不包含卡片渲染出的正文，但 id 与几何数据在）。仅用于排障，请指向临时路径，用完删除。

## 开发

```bash
npm install      # 会通过 prepare 构建 dist/
npm run typecheck
npm test
npm run build
```

测试需要 [Bun](https://bun.sh)（`bun test`）。测试必须带 `--conditions=browser`：solid-js 的 `node` 导出条件会解析到 SSR 构建，其中 `createMemo` 永不失效，controller 的测试就会对着一个冻结的 view 做断言。`src/geom.test.ts` 覆盖纯几何；`src/controller.test.ts` 用假宿主驱动真实 controller，不需要终端。

模块划分与必须守住的不变式见 [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md)。

# Changelog

All notable changes to this project. Format follows
[Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/en/1.1.0/), versioning is
[SemVer](https://semver.org/).

## [0.2.0] — 2026-11-18

Targets OpenCode 2.3.2 (was 2.0.27) and OpenTUI ≥ 0.8.4 (was 0.5.17). The TUI plugin API is
unchanged across that range — `context`, `index`, `plugin` and `solid` type definitions are
byte-identical, and the host still publishes the same ten slot paths — so nothing had to be
migrated architecturally.

### Fixed

- The hover card now anchors to the rail row the tick was actually painted on. It previously
  derived that row as `i0 + k`, which only holds in the sliding-window layout: with 5 turns on
  a 41-row rail the first tick sits on row 16 while the card was drawn on row 1.
- The card follows its tick through scrolls and window slides instead of closing on the first
  scroll event. It closes only when that turn leaves the window or is no longer painted.
- Wheel-over-rail no longer dismisses an open card, matching the JSX path.

### Changed

- One pointer sink for both sources (native JSX handlers and the raw SGR parser), with a single
  `downRow`, so a click delivered by both cannot jump twice. The first native event that
  resolves a real rail row retires the SGR parser; `debug().pointerSource` reports which won.
- Jumps prefer the host's `scrollChildIntoView(id, { align: "start" })` and wait on the
  scrollbox's `afterLayout` (bounded at 48 ms) instead of guessing frame counts; the retry
  ladder shrank from 3 attempts to 2.
- `@opentui/solid` and `solid-js` are runtime dependencies, so an install always resolves what
  the built plugin imports. `prepare` builds `dist/`, so Git-spec installs work too.
- Relative imports carry `.js` extensions; the built output loads under Node as well as Bun.

### Added

- `src/controller.test.ts`: the real controller against a fake host — card anchor, follow/close
  rules, click de-duplication, the alignment rung, the native→SGR latch, cross-source wheel
  coalescing.
- CI on Linux and macOS; `CHANGELOG`, `CONTRIBUTING`, `SECURITY`, issue template.

## 0.1.0 — 2026-10

Initial implementation: per-turn ticks, chevrons, dwell-hover preview card, click-to-jump,
capability tiers 0–3, the four-rung jump ladder, a durable `Alt+R` toggle, and a debug channel.
